author: felicepantaleo
body: Fill the per-cell columns with `tbb::parallel_for` instead of a serial loop. The running silicon and scint block counters are replaced by the arithmetic block-local index `(i - nBarrel, i - nBarrel - nSilicon)` so every iteration writes disjoint rows and RecHitTools is only read. The HGCal fill of 6.08M cells drops from 2844 ms to 332 ms using 8 threads without any difference in the output SoA.
title: TICLGeom: parallelize the geometry SoA build with tbb::parallel_for
